subject: Quarterline prep: OKR micro-checks, runway risks, and leadership asks
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Leadership Distro <leadership@redwood.com>, Tara Singh <tara@acme.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quarterline prep: OKR micro-checks, runway risks, and leadership asks

Team — sharing a concise update to surface the micro-metrics we want on the QBR slide deck and call out near-term runway risks. Attachment: QBR_runbook_v2.pdf and OKR_micrometrics_sheet.xlsx (latest tab = "March snapshot").

Wins
- Customer-facing latency median improved to 85ms (up from 115ms last month) after batching changes on the serving runtime.
- Three pilot accounts migrated to Dedicated pool; billing check-ins indicate improved unit economics.
- Eval harness shows no significant quality regression after quantization profile 3.

Risks / runway items
- Cost per M tokens for large context workloads has a +18% variance vs. forecast; likely tied to spike in long-sequence sampling from two mid-market customers (Acme being one).
- One of the Dedicated clusters (eu-west-2) reported sustained 3% error-rate increase for 2 days — root cause pending (infra vs. kernel mismatch).
- QBR artifacts: we need finalized deck figures by 2028-03-22 EOD or risk not making the executive packet.

Asks (clear owners / short asks)
- Karthik: confirm the eu-west-2 incident RCA and mitigation (ETA 2028-03-18).
- Soojin: prioritize a 2-hour dry run for the QBR performance slide with product + infra (proposal: 2028-03-20 10:00 PT). 
- Laura: approve a one-week exception to the Reserved Capacity burst policy for Acme to smooth QBR demo traffic (need approval by 2028-03-19).
- All: review the OKR micro-metrics sheet and add any change requests inline in the Drive link.

Quick context for Acme: Tara — thanks for the heads-up on heavier long-context evaluation. We're tracking per-request length distribution and will loop you in on the mitigation plan.

Attach: QBR_runbook_v2.pdf, OKR_micrometrics_sheet.xlsx

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Director, Product Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

---

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Leadership Distro <leadership@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-16T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quarterline prep: OKR micro-checks, runway risks, and leadership asks

Marissa — quick technical update and a small ask.

- eu-west-2 spike: preliminary signal points to a kernel selection mismatch after the recent autoscaler patch (we can reproduce in staging with the long-sequence sampling profile). Team is rolling a targeted kernel pin to the affected fleet. ETA for the pin rollout: 2028-03-17 20:00 UTC.
- Cost variance: the anomaly stems from an increase in prefix lengths for a small cohort (~2.4% of requests) plus increased sampling temperature in their workflows; Ops is throttling sampling for those sessions today as a short-term fix.

Ask: I need a short follow-up slot (15m) with Acme's infra contact and Tara to confirm expected request length distribution when they demo. Proposed: 2028-03-18 09:30 PT. Can someone own scheduling?

On Mar 15, 2028, at 09:12, Marissa Cole wrote:
> Team — sharing a concise update to surface the micro-metrics we want on the QBR slide deck and call out near-term runway risks. Attachment: QBR_runbook_v2.pdf and OKR_micrometrics_sheet.xlsx (latest tab = "March snapshot").

> Wins

>
Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Platform | Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-18T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quarterline prep: OKR micro-checks, runway risks, and leadership asks

Appreciate the crisp summary, Marissa. A couple quick decisions: 

- Approve the one-week burst exception for Acme conditional on a short commitment from their side to throttle demo sampling if we see a repeat spike. I'll send a note to Legal/Finance for the temporary change and copy Ops.
- Karthik: thank you — own the eu-west-2 pin rollout and confirm completion in this thread when done.
- Soojin: please confirm the dry-run slot (Mar 20 10:00 PT) and include platform instrumentation checks (traces + token-level cost).

I'll consolidate these into the QBR packet and handle the timing ask for final slides.

Laura Bennett
VP, Business Ops | Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Quarterline prep: OKR micro-checks, runway risks, and leadership asks

Quick closure notes: 

- eu-west-2: pin rollout completed 2028-03-17 20:05 UTC. Error rate returned to baseline. Karthik and infra team — great coordination.
- Acme burst exception: Laura, thanks — legal/finance looped; Tara confirmed the throttle commitment in email chain outside this thread.
- QBR deck: I ran the dry run on 2028-03-20 10:00 PT; attached latency_cost_snapshot.png to show side-by-side before/after batching. Small ask for the deck: please use the "median + 90th" layout on slide 4 to highlight tail improvements.

Marissa — I updated the Drive runbook with a final checklist and minor copy edits. All artifacts are in the related Drive link.

Best,
Soojin Lee
VP, Engineering | Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.com
